prompts: Merge these two notes: Spaced Repetition and Spaced repetition learning.
These two Atlas notes are duplicates, fold them into one.
Slå ihop de här två anteckningarna, de säger samma sak.
Lint found two notes on the same idea. Clean that up.
Merge Habit Loops into Habit Formation, but Habit Loops only overlaps in part and the two disagree on the cue length.

assertions.check: The agent reads every candidate in full and checks backlinks and index.md lines before proposing anything.
The agent proposes a survivor, shows what moves in and how many links change, and edits no file until the human approves.
The proposed survivor is the older note or the one with more inbound links, with the reason stated.
The survivor keeps both notes' Citations (renumbered, no repeats) and gets the loser's title in aliases:.
Where the notes disagree, the disagreement is recorded under a ## Tensions heading in the survivor instead of silently picking one side.
Link repointing, rename and delete happen through Obsidian (app, Note Composer or CLI), never by shell mv, rm or file-system rename.
The loser is deleted so it lands in Obsidian's trash, not hard-deleted.
The agent verifies that no wikilink still points at the loser after the merge.
When the notes overlap only in part, the agent says they are not duplicates and suggests related: links instead of merging.
The loser's line is removed from the folder index.md and the survivor's summary is refreshed if it changed.
Atlas/log.md gets a '**Removal**' line naming the loser and the survivor, plus an '**Update**' line for the survivor, under today's date.
A merge entry is added to AI-OS/log.
